sections.title: The boat moves forward with the swords aboard
sections.bodyMarkdown:
A narrow boat stretches from the foreground toward the right. A person stands at the stern using a pole. Ahead sits someone wrapped in yellow-brown fabric, with a smaller figure beside them. Both face away from us. Six swords stand in the forward part of the boat, their handles at different heights and their blades obscuring part of the view ahead.

The water nearest the boat has distinct ripples; farther away it is smoother, with scattered trees along the shore. The swords have not been left behind, and no one is celebrating. This can suggest moving on with unresolved matters, but the image does not explain the passengers’ relationship, their reason for leaving or whether the destination will satisfy them. [View the image examined for this article](https://github.com/guangtoulee/destinypixel/blob/284f7641e41dcaa6685d2d387e31245ca8264d66/public/tarot/rws/six-of-swords.webp)

sections.title: The original includes routes and commissions
sections.bodyMarkdown:
In the text labelled 1911, Waite calls the standing person a ferryman and describes a smooth passage with a load within their capacity. His meanings include water travel, routes, an envoy, a commission and an expedient. Reversed, he writes of declarations, confession and publicity, rather than a single meaning of being unable to leave.

Transition, assistance and unfinished matters are this article’s modern reflective extensions. Movement is not restricted to long-distance travel, and a boat in the image does not predict a move, emigration or a particular itinerary. [Check Waite’s original entry](https://original.sacred-texts.com/tarot/pkt/pktsw06.htm)

It is especially useful to ask who is doing the work of moving things forward. Someone poles the boat while others may only be able to sit for now. Cooperation does not require everyone to contribute in the same way at the same moment. Accepting practical help is also a capacity that makes change possible.

sections.title: A handover matters more than an elegant fresh start
sections.bodyMarkdown:
When changing teams, list open work, where materials are stored and who will take over. Old responsibilities then have somewhere to go, and the new arrangement can progress even while your feelings are mixed.

Two people who want to stop a pattern of repeated arguments can begin by discussing one issue at an agreed time, perhaps with help from someone they both trust. If you miss your old life after relocating, that does not prove the move was wrong. Establish small routines for shopping, commuting and contacting friends so the new place gradually becomes livable.

articleMarkdown:
# Six of Swords Meaning: Carry Unfinished Things Toward the Next Shore

In one sentence: A transition can begin with one workable step before every worry has been released.

Keywords: Transition · Companionship · Steady movement

Upright at a glance: Use a route and practical support to move gradually away from an unsustainable situation.

Reversed at a glance: The handover or direction is still unclear; address the point that is blocking movement.

The moving boxes are packed, but your feelings are still in the old place. Sometimes action changes first and emotion follows more slowly.

## The boat moves forward with the swords aboard

A narrow boat stretches from the foreground toward the right. A person stands at the stern using a pole. Ahead sits someone wrapped in yellow-brown fabric, with a smaller figure beside them. Both face away from us. Six swords stand in the forward part of the boat, their handles at different heights and their blades obscuring part of the view ahead.

The water nearest the boat has distinct ripples; farther away it is smoother, with scattered trees along the shore. The swords have not been left behind, and no one is celebrating. This can suggest moving on with unresolved matters, but the image does not explain the passengers’ relationship, their reason for leaving or whether the destination will satisfy them. [View the image examined for this article](https://github.com/guangtoulee/destinypixel/blob/284f7641e41dcaa6685d2d387e31245ca8264d66/public/tarot/rws/six-of-swords.webp)

## The original includes routes and commissions

In the text labelled 1911, Waite calls the standing person a ferryman and describes a smooth passage with a load within their capacity. His meanings include water travel, routes, an envoy, a commission and an expedient. Reversed, he writes of declarations, confession and publicity, rather than a single meaning of being unable to leave.

Transition, assistance and unfinished matters are this article’s modern reflective extensions. Movement is not restricted to long-distance travel, and a boat in the image does not predict a move, emigration or a particular itinerary. [Check Waite’s original entry](https://original.sacred-texts.com/tarot/pkt/pktsw06.htm)

## Upright: Make the next step workable

Upright, the card can suggest moving from a high-friction situation toward a more manageable arrangement. You may not feel at ease or know the destination fully, but you can establish a route, handover tasks and support.

It is especially useful to ask who is doing the work of moving things forward. Someone poles the boat while others may only be able to sit for now. Cooperation does not require everyone to contribute in the same way at the same moment. Accepting practical help is also a capacity that makes change possible.

## Reversed: Ask which connection is still missing

Reversed, the card can draw attention to uneven transitions: arrangements have changed but habits have not, or someone has left without a necessary explanation. Perhaps the route itself needs reconsidering. Find the specific obstacle rather than calling all hesitation a fear of growth. A lack of practical resources can also make movement difficult.

## A handover matters more than an elegant fresh start

When changing teams, list open work, where materials are stored and who will take over. Old responsibilities then have somewhere to go, and the new arrangement can progress even while your feelings are mixed.

Two people who want to stop a pattern of repeated arguments can begin by discussing one issue at an agreed time, perhaps with help from someone they both trust. If you miss your old life after relocating, that does not prove the move was wrong. Establish small routines for shopping, commuting and contacting friends so the new place gradually becomes livable.

## Practice: Map a short route

Divide a page into “Now,” “Next stop” and “Who or what can help.” Make the next stop a near-term action, such as arranging a handover or finding a contact. Add one worry that will still travel with you, as a reminder that you need not pretend everything is resolved.

## Leaving does not make everything better automatically

The Six of Swords does not promise a happier far shore or require you to leave everyone behind alone. Examine the route, the load and the help available. Whether life improves must be answered by what actually happens after the move.

## Read next

Four of Swords: Distinguish pausing to recover from beginning a transition; Eight of Cups: Compare supported movement with actively seeking a new direction.

sourceRecord.title: 宝剑六牌义 带着未完的事走向下一岸
sourceRecord.plainLanguageSummary: 过渡可以先从可行的一步开始，不必等所有心事都放下。
sourceRecord.hook: 搬走的箱子已经打包，心情却还留在原地。改变有时先发生在行动上，感受会慢一些。
sourceRecord.uprightQuickTake: 借助路线和支持，逐步离开难以继续的处境。
sourceRecord.reversedQuickTake: 交接或方向仍未理顺，先处理卡住移动的环节。

sections.title: 船向前走 剑也在船上
paragraphs: 一条窄船从近处伸向画面右方，船尾的人站着撑篙。前方坐着披着黄褐色布料的人，身旁还有一个较小的身影，两人都背对观看者。六柄剑竖立在船的前部，剑柄高低错落，遮住部分前方视野。

船近侧的水面有明显波纹，远处较平静，岸边零散生着树。人物没有把剑留在出发处，船上也没有欢呼动作。我们可以据此思考「带着尚未解决的事前进」，但画面并没有交代乘客关系、出发原因或终点是否圆满。 [查看本篇实看牌面](https://github.com/guangtoulee/destinypixel/blob/284f7641e41dcaa6685d2d387e31245ca8264d66/public/tarot/rws/six-of-swords.webp)

sections.title: 原文里有路线 也有委托
paragraphs: Waite 的1911年标注本把画中人称为渡船者，认为路线平顺、负担在其能力范围内。牌义涉及水路旅行、路线、使者、委托与权宜方式。逆位则写到声明、坦白和公开等，并非统一的「无法离开」。
本文以过渡、协助和未完事项来解释生活情境，是现代反思延伸。它不把移动固定为远行，更不会因为画里有船，就预测搬家、移民或具体行程。 [核对 Waite 单牌原文](https://original.sacred-texts.com/tarot/pkt/pktsw06.htm)

sections.title: 正位 先让下一步走得通
paragraphs: 正位可读作从高摩擦状态转向较可处理的安排。你不一定已经轻松，也未必完全确定终点，但可以先建立路线、交接事项和支援。
这张牌尤其适合检查谁在承担推进工作。有人掌篙，有人暂时只能坐着，合作并不要求每个人此刻付出同样方式的力量。接受实际帮助，也是一种让转变发生的能力。

sections.title: 逆位 问是哪一段还没接上
paragraphs: 逆位可提示过渡中的反复：安排已变，旧习惯还在；人已离开，必要的说明却没说清。也可能是路线本身不适合，需要重新选择。先找具体卡点，别把迟疑统统说成害怕成长，现实资源不足也会使移动困难。

sections.title: 交接比漂亮的重新开始更重要
paragraphs: 换团队时，列出待办、资料所在位置和接手人，让旧工作有去处。这样即使心情复杂，新安排仍能往前走。
两个人约定结束反复争吵的模式，可以先改用固定时间谈一个议题，并请双方都信任的人帮助梳理。迁居之后若仍怀念旧生活，不必因此认定搬错了；先建立买菜、通勤和联络朋友的小路线，让新地方逐渐可生活。

sections.title: 练习 画一张短途路线
paragraphs: 把纸分成「现在」「下一站」「需要谁或什么」三栏。下一站只写能在近期完成的动作，例如约一次交接、找一个联系人。再列一件仍会同行的心事，提醒自己不必假装已经全部解决。

sections.title: 离开不等于一切自动变好
paragraphs: 宝剑六不保证另一岸更幸福，也不要求你独自离开所有人。可供检查的是路线、负荷和帮助；真正能否改善生活，需要由行动后的事实来回答。
